scope: Current published media Wasm encoder availability and native video encoder selection; not a codec feasibility or rejection benchmark

nativeSelection.encoderLookup: libtheora when WITHIN_THEORA_ENCODE and OGV; otherwise AV_CODEC_ID_VP9, AV_CODEC_ID_VP8 or AV_CODEC_ID_MPEG4
nativeSelection.manifestOtherVideoEncoder: h263 is listed in the compiled encoder inventory but is not a selectable video output codec

notImplementedFreshMediaOutputs.existingCoverage: source decode, standards-compatible stream copy/remux, and elementary extraction do not prove fresh H.264 encoding
compatible WebM copy and IVF extraction/wrapping without video decode; image AVIF encoding is a separate engine and not a media AV1 encoder
source decode, compatible packet copy, elementary extraction/wrapping and conversion to other encoded codecs
source decode, compatible packet copy and elementary extraction; fresh encoding additionally requires the specification's legal/build acceptance

decoderBoundary: The published FFmpeg manifest installs no AV1/VP8/VP9 video decoder. Their packet-copy, elementary wrapping/extraction and audio-extraction routes do not prove genuine source-video decode/re-encode. Separate image engines do not establish a media decoder fallback.
nextAction: Investigate a source-pinned specialist H.264 encoder first: real bounded native/Wasm build feasibility, identical-setting quality/speed/memory measurements, production browser I/O and independent validators. Apply the unchanged full acceptance gate before publishing. Do not relabel absence as intentionally unsupported without measured or legal evidence.
limitations: The original specification requires broad practical codec coverage, not every theoretical input-extension/output-extension pair. This inventory makes the currently uninvestigated encoder surface explicit without pretending decoding equals encoding.
No codec has been newly rejected on performance, memory or licensing evidence by this inventory.
No new route, binary, public selector option, memory certification or performance result is added.
